card.name: Space before minimum time or amount
card.fires_on: The space right after "at least" or "minimum of" in dosing instructions, just before a number such as 2, 30 or 8 and its unit (hours, minutes, ounces).

modes.label: Minimum gap before or after food or other drugs
modes.description: Space after "at least" before an hours or minutes figure about spacing doses from meals or other drugs.
modes.example: Swallow tablets whole at least<< >>30 minutes before any food or beverage

modes.label: Minimum gap between doses
modes.description: Space after "minimum of" before the hours that must separate doses.
modes.example: with a minimum of<< >>8 hours between doses

modes.label: Minimum amount of water
modes.description: Space after "at least" before a volume of water to swallow with the drug.
modes.example: Swallow oral solution followed by at least<< >>2 ounces of water.
